MaxWoundNotification.Title: Max Wound Mismatch
MaxWoundNotification.Body:
The max Wounds value on the original token does not match the max Wounds value on the new token. Please open the new token and adjust the max Wounds manually.

I'd also appreciate if you would open an issue on GitHub describing how this happened.

CompendiumWarning.Title: Compendium Actors
CompendiumWarning.Body:
Directly using compendium actors is not supported with the Transient Compendium Actors Library module enabled.

Please either enable that module or import the actor into your world first and then use the imported actor.

DeleteTokenWarning.Title: Confirm Delete?
DeleteTokenWarning.SourceBody:
This token is marked as the source of a shape change. Deleting this token will break the ability to revert the shape change.

Are you sure you want to delete this token?
DeleteTokenWarning.CreatedBody:
This token is was created as a result of a shape change. Deleting this token will break the ability to revert to the original token.

Are you sure you want to delete this token?

SUCCWarning.Title: SUCC Not Configured
SUCCWarning.Body:
The SUCC module is installed and SUCC support is enabled in the options for SWADE Shape Changer but the shape change condition has not been enabled in the SUCC settings.

To fix this, open the SUCC settings, open the Default Conditions menu, select the Expanded Powers tab, and enable Shape Change.

Alternatively, you can disable the SUCC support setting in this module.

SUCCDisableConfirmation.Title: SUCC Support Disabled
SUCCDisableConfirmation.Body: SUCC support has been disabled. You can reenable this at any time from the SWADE Shape Changer options.

TcalWarning.Title: TCAL Recommended
TcalWarning.Body:
The Transient Compendium Actor Library is not active.

It is highly recommended to enable this module for use with SWADE Shape Changer as it will allow you to shape change into compendium actors directly.

Settings.UseSUCCHint: Use SWADE Ultimate Condition Changer to add/remove a shape change condition executing a shape change. Requires the shape change condition to be enabled in SUCC.
Settings.UseSequencerHint: When enabled, executing a shape change can be configured to work with Sequencer animations.
Settings.SequencerAnimHint: The Sequencer animation to use when changing or reverting shape. If the animation does not exist, the Sequencer flow is skipped.
Settings.SequencerDelayHint: The delay, in milliseconds, after starting the animation before changing shape.
